description: Points your domain and its www at your workspaced workspace, so the sites you run there answer on it. The domain's current A and AAAA records and its www record are replaced, so a website already on the domain stops answering there. Email (MX) and other records are not changed.
variableDescription: ipv4/ipv6: the workspace's public addresses; vmid: the workspace's id, whose name under vm.workspaced.online www points at
